narr: Heavy rains brought extensive street flooding in the city of Pocatello.
ev: Extensive street flooding in Pocatello with several becoming impassable. The Center Street underpass was shut down after two feet of water collected.
lsr: IDAHO STATE JOURNAL REPORTS SEVERAL STREETS IMPASSABLE DUE TO FLOODING AND CENTER STREET UNDERPASS SHUT DOWN AFTER COLLECTING AT LEAST 2 FEET OF WATER.
